subject: OrangeLeaf — Sales→CS acceptance & runbook checklist
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@orangeleaf.io>, Chris Patel <chris.patel@orangeleaf.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: OrangeLeaf — Sales→CS acceptance & runbook checklist

Team — putting the finalized handoff in writing so CS has a tight checklist for kickoff. Quick context: OrangeLeaf signed on 2028-06-22 for a 12-month Dedicated plan (2 reserved pods, burst capacity). Goal is live with the Redwood API for chat/embeddings by 2028-08-15. Key success criteria per the SOW: 99th percentile latency under 400ms for chat endpoints at their expected load (avg 18 rps), SSO configured, and data retention controls documented.

What Im handing off now:
- Commercial: committed MRR, billing contact, and DocuSign attached (OrangeLeaf_Signed_DocuSign.pdf).
- Scope: chat + embeddings + prefix caching; no custom model training.
- Dates: kickoff week: 2028-07-09; dev sandbox access by 2028-07-02; target go-live 2028-08-15.

Immediate asks for CS (please reply with owners by EOD Wed):
1) Primary CS owner for onboarding and weekly cadence
2) Technical lead for integration and SSO work (customer and Redwood side)
3) Confirmation of what runbook templates well use and any OrangeLeaf-specific deviations

Assumptions and open risks:
- OrangeLeaf expects HIPAA-adjacent support; customer will sign BAAs via legal but well need to confirm audit log retention settings.
- They expect IP allowlist for the Dedicated pool (see network_requirements.pdf stub attached).
- A portion of their call volume spikes into evenings PST — recommend scheduling early autoscaling run.

Attachments referenced: OrangeLeaf_SOW_v3.pdf, OL_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx, network_requirements.pdf.

Thanks — will join the first kickoff.

— Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@orangeleaf.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrangeLeaf — Sales→CS acceptance & runbook checklist

Thanks Sergio — looping in CS owners and confirming well take the lead. Owners below and a couple clarifying Qs.

Owners: 
- Primary CS Owner: Marissa Cole (me) — onboarding lead and escalation owner.
- Technical PM (Redwood): Karthik Iyer — will coordinate sandbox & SSO.
- Billing/SPoC: Ben Carter will manage billing/contract questions.

Clarifying Qs for OrangeLeaf (Emma):
1) Can you confirm the SSO provider (Okta/Azure AD) and whether Okta Just-in-Time provisioning is required?
2) Are there any PII fields we need to mask at tokenization time beyond PHI?
3) Do you have a preferred kickoff date/time during the 2028-07-09 week? Were proposing Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Runbook approach: Ill populate our standard sales->cs runbook template and attach a tailored checklist back to this thread by Friday 2028-06-29. Karthik — please add any non-standard network/IP recommendations to the runbook (I saw the stub attached).

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@orangeleaf.io>
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2028 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrangeLeaf — Sales→CS acceptance & runbook checklist

Adding some technical notes for the runbook and a short pre-kickoff checklist: 

Tech notes:
- Sandbox access: we need to provision an API key tied to their sandbox project by 2028-07-02. Dev Patel will create the sandbox tenant and share keys via the secure vault.
- SSO: support for Okta and Azure AD. If OrangeLeaf wants Just-in-Time, we need SCIM provisioning enabled on their side; otherwise OIDC SSO is sufficient.
- Network: they asked for static egress allowlist — recommend using our Dedicated egress IP block A (see network_requirements.pdf). Customer needs to confirm their firewall rules ahead of kickoff.
- Model variant: start with rdl-chat-v2 (quantized variant) to meet latency targets; plan to test rdl-chat-v3 if quality regressions appear.

Pre-kickoff checklist (target completion before 2028-07-09):
1) Sandbox tenant + API keys issued (Dev)
2) Signed BAA returned to legal (Ben)
3) Okta/Azure SSO metadata shared (Emma)
4) Network allowlist configured on customer firewall (Emma/IT)

Ill attach a short network requirements PDF to the runbook.

— Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@orangeleaf.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Patel <chris.patel@orangeleaf.io>, legal@orangeleaf.io
Date: Thu, 30 Jun 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrangeLeaf — Sales→CS acceptance & runbook checklist

Thanks, Sergio/Marissa/Karthik — appreciate the clear handoff. A few quick items from our side: 

- SSO: we use Okta, and wed like SCIM provisioning enabled. Ill share the Okta admin metadata by EOD Mon (2028-07-02).
- Network: our infra team will apply the allowlist for Redwood Dedicated egress IPs the week of 2028-07-02.
- BAA: signed and returned — attached as OrangeLeaf_Signed_DocuSign.pdf (we uploaded the signed DocuSign to the folder and forwarded the DocuSign link).
- Kickoff: Tue 2028-07-09 at 10:00 AM PST works for us. Please send a calendar invite when the runbook is ready.

Forwarding Sergios original SOW and the mutual action plan to our procurement and infra leads for visibility. Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Emma Jenkins
Director of Integrations | OrangeLeaf Healthtech
emma.jenkins@orangeleaf.io | +1 (206) 555-4001
